Class ShapeDrawing

Provides extension methods for drawing shapes and outlines using lists of Vector2 points.

Remarks

This static class contains various helper methods for rendering polygons, outlines, and vertices with customizable styles and transformations.

Methods

DrawLinesScaled(List<Vector2>, Transform2D, LineDrawingInfo, float, float)

Draws the polygon as a series of lines, scaling each side towards its origin by a specified factor, using a Transform2D.

public static void DrawLinesScaled(this List<Vector2> relativePoints, Transform2D transform, LineDrawingInfo lineInfo, float sideScaleFactor, float sideScaleOrigin = 0.5)

Parameters

relativePoints List<Vector2>

The list of relative points defining the polygon.

transform Transform2D

The transformation to apply (position, scale, rotation).

lineInfo LineDrawingInfo

The line drawing information (thickness, color, cap type, etc.).

sideScaleFactor float

The scale factor for each side:

  • 0: no polygon is drawn
  • 1: the normal polygon is drawn
  • 0.5: each side is half as long
sideScaleOrigin float

The point along the line to scale from, in both directions. Default is 0.5 (midpoint).

DrawOutlinePercentage(List<Vector2>, float, float, ColorRgba, LineCapType, int)

Draws a specified percentage of the polygon's outline.

public static void DrawOutlinePercentage(this List<Vector2> shapePoints, float f, float lineThickness, ColorRgba color, LineCapType capType = LineCapType.CappedExtended, int capPoints = 2)

Parameters

shapePoints List<Vector2>

The list of points defining the polygon.

f float

The percentage of the outline to draw, with the following behavior:

  • If negative, the outline is drawn in the clockwise direction.
  • The integer part determines the starting corner index.
  • The fractional part determines the percentage of the outline to draw.
  • Example: 0.35 starts at corner 0 and draws 35% in CCW; -2.7 starts at corner 2 and draws 70% in CW.
lineThickness float

The thickness of the outline.

color ColorRgba

The color of the outline.

capType LineCapType

The type of line cap to use at the ends of each segment.

capPoints int

The number of points used for the cap.

Remarks

Useful for progress indicators or animated outlines.
